subject: Re: PilotCloud annual prepay — invoice automation & drawdown sentinel
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rao <maya@pilotcloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: PilotCloud annual prepay — invoice automation & drawdown sentinel

Hi Maya,

Following up from last week's call — we want to automate the invoicing cadence for PilotCloud's annual prepay and implement a lightweight drawdown sentinel so both teams get notified when cumulative usage crosses tranche thresholds. Goal: reduce manual AP handoffs and remove the monthly CSV choke-point.

What we need from you to scope the work:
- AP contact and preferred remit method (ACH / wire / e-invoice).
- Sample invoice that your accounting team expects (line-level VAT, PO reference placement).
- Bank remit details / beneficiary name (we can accept a PDF stub).
- Your PO number for the annual prepay (so we can map invoices).

Tentative timeline from our side: if we get sample invoice + bank details by Oct 4 we can stand up the automation and sentinel rule by Oct 15 (pilot in sandbox, production roll the following week). Is that realistic for PilotCloud?

I attached our MOP routing template (CSV) to show the mapping fields we use when we do automated remittance. If you prefer, your AP can send a file in your current format and we'll map it.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so I can loop in Ops.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_mop_routing_template.csv (CSV, 6KB)]

From: Maya Rao <maya@pilotcloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: PilotCloud Finance <billing@pilotcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotCloud annual prepay — invoice automation & drawdown sentinel

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note.

AP contact: billing@pilotcloud.com (shared mailbox monitored by our AP team).
PO#: PC-2026-091 — please include this on invoice header and the accounting reference field.

We can accept the following remit methods: ACH (US), wire, or e-invoice (CSV/UBL). I'll attach a sample invoice and our bank remit PDF. Our invoices must include a separate VAT line if VAT applies; we have VAT registration in the EU only (attached VAT ID in the invoice sample).

We are comfortable with your proposed timeline; AP is ready to run a pilot on Oct 15 provided the mapping is validated. We will need a DocuSign for the annual addendum so our legal and procurement can sign.

Attached: pilotcloud_invoice_sample.pdf, pilotcloud_mop_bank_details.pdf

—
Maya Rao
Head of Finance Operations
PilotCloud

[Attachment: pilotcloud_mop_bank_details.pdf (PDF, 8KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotCloud annual prepay — invoice automation & drawdown sentinel

Karthik / Grace — quick internal note after reviewing Maya's sample.

Observations / asks:
- The invoice sample includes VAT as a separate line (good). We need to confirm whether PilotCloud expects us to remit gross (VAT included) or net (VAT shown, VAT payable to PilotCloud). That affects our AR entries and whether we need to include our VAT reg in the invoice header.
- Can Maya share the exact invoice header format (company name, VAT id, remit-to address) as plain text? PDF is fine but a simple header makes mapping faster.
- For the drawdown sentinel: suggest thresholds at 50%, 80%, 100% of tranche. Each alert should include remaining committed USD and token-equivalent burn if possible. Ops will need a webhook payload sample to implement.

If PilotCloud requires any specific invoice numbering pattern for matching (e.g., INV-PC-YYYY-####), flag it now.

Kimberly
Director, Billing Ops — Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Karthik — attaching the CSV remittance template we use for straight-through processing. AP will push ACH on the 1st business day following invoice receipt.

Notes:
- We require a VAT line if VAT applies. Please include our VAT id on the invoice header exactly as shown in the sample.
- Invoice number pattern: INV-PC-YYYY-#### (we use that for auto-matching).
- Remittance: ACH (preferred). Our bank details are in pilotcloud_mop_bank_details.pdf.
- We can provide a machine-friendly JSON webhook for remittance confirmations if Redwood prefers to consume webhooks.

Attaching: rcv-m_routing_template.csv (CSV, 4KB) — this maps to the fields our AP system ingests.

Also — we will need a DocuSign for the annual prepay addendum. Please send the link once you have the final MOP mapping.

Thanks,
Maya

Subject: Re: PilotCloud annual prepay — invoice automation & drawdown sentinel

Maya — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Confirming mutual next steps and owners:

1) Invoice header + VAT mapping (PilotCloud) — Maya / billing@pilotcloud.com — due Oct 7.
2) Redwood mapping of CSV -> internal ledger fields (Kimberly) — due Oct 9.
3) Drawdown sentinel: thresholds 50% / 80% / 100% (Ops) — implement webhook payload by Oct 12.
4) DocuSign: Redwood to generate annual-addendum and share link (Karthik) — send by Oct 9 so PilotCloud can sign before pilot.
5) Pilot run: Oct 15 (sandbox), production the week after pending sign-off and a green remittance test.

I attached a short mutual-action-plan with the milestone dates. Grace — can you please confirm Ops can deliver the webhook sample by Oct 12 and the sentinel alert formatting (JSON) for PilotCloud?

Maya — once DocuSign is in flight, we will schedule a 30-minute validation call with AP to exercise one test invoice and an ACH remittance.

Thanks all — this keeps us on track for the Oct pilot.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
